summary.en: A random attacker is targeting women. Two victims survived, but Himena Shinozaki is not lucky. Location: In front of Hikaru Komori's apartment Victim: Himena Shinozaki Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Mysterious man Someone named Hikaru, who lived near the crime scene, witnesses the murder. The next day, the police are investigating the crime scene when Kogoro, Conan, and Ran appears. Conan notices that someone is looking from a house nearby. A woman tells him that it is Komori residence, where Hikaru and his mother live. Hikaru is known as shut-in, currently unemployed, and a Yoko Okino's big fan. Kogoro and Conan try to question Hikaru, but he only text his mother that he did not see anything. Conan deduces that Hikaru might actually see something or the culprit might saw Hikaru. Later, Conan notice that one of Hikaru's shoes is dirtier than other shoes. His mother then realizes that some Yoko Okino sneakers is missing. Kogoro, Conan, and Ran decide to go home. When there is a news coverage about Yoko Okino Dome Tour, Conan realizes what actually happened.
